look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: check the large, heart-shaped, untoothed leaves arranged opposite or in whorls, then inspect upright terminal clusters of large white, purple-and-yellow-marked trumpet flowers; later look for long narrow hanging seed capsules.
diagnostic_image_needs: mature long capsule and winged seeds
comparison with Catalpa bignonioides (not yet resolved)
